Curated Media & Technical Walkthroughs

Watch these technical demonstrations prior to completing your workshop:

  • Deconstructing the IIIF Image URL: Dynamic manipulation of region bounding boxes, percentage scaling, and rotation parameters via terminal curl requests (15 mins).
  • Authoring a IIIF 3.0 Presentation Manifest: Building a JSON-LD manifest from scratch with Canvases, dimensions, and image services (20 mins).
  • Connecting Mirador to TEI Facsimile Markup: Using SVG surface zones to link transcription lines directly to high-resolution parchment pixels (18 mins).
